title: UseCaseMap
description: Schema for use-case map architecture diagram data. Drives the HTML template rendering in create-use-case-map skill.

items.description: Top-level sections (e.g. "On-Demand CLI Commands", "Scheduled Batch Commands")

Section.description: A major grouping of flows. Rendered as <h2> with collapsible section wrapper.

SubSection.description: A sub-section grouping of related flows. Rendered as <h3>.

items.description: Columns representing architectural layers (CLI, UseCase, Port, Adapter, HTTP, etc.)

Column.description: A single architectural layer column (e.g. CLI Command, UseCase Command, Port, Adapter, HTTP Client). Rendered as <div class="column"> with a <div class="column-header">.

title.description: Column header label (e.g. "CLI Command", "Port", "Adapter"). Also used as CSS class for colouring.

color.description: CSS colour class for the column header and its nodes. Must match a known layer class: cli, ctrl, uc, handler, port, adapter, http, event, listnr, cb, indirect.

items.description: Units within this column — either a regular unit, a UseCase, Query, Event, or Listener.

Unit.description: A single node in the diagram. Rendered as <div class="node">. Can be nested to represent sub-command delegation chains.

title.description: Node title text (e.g. class name). Rendered as <span class="node-title-main">.

info.description: Secondary info line (e.g. fully-qualified namespace or context). Rendered as <span class="ns">.

color.description: CSS colour class for this node. Overrides the column colour if set. Must match a known layer class: cli, ctrl, uc, handler, port, adapter, http, event, listnr, cb, indirect. Also supports the "weak" modifier (e.g. "uc weak", "port weak") for handlers that do not call the Erp port.

indentation.description: Nesting depth. 0 = top-level node within column. Each increment adds visual indentation via margin-left and dashed left border.

items.description: Nested sub-units. Represents sub-command delegation: a handler dispatching child commands.

type.description: Type identifier for this node. One of: unit, command, query, event, listener. Used by renderers to determine layout and arrow styling.

UseCase.description: A UseCase unit, which is a Unit composed of a Command (type Unit, typically colour "uc") and a Handler (type Unit, typically colour "handler"). Rendered as <div class="node-group sync|async"> wrapping two <div class="node"> elements.

command.description: The UseCase Command unit (typically colour "uc"). Rendered as <div class="node uc">.

handler.description: The CommandHandler unit (typically colour "handler"). Rendered as <div class="node handler">.

dispatchMode.description: Dispatch mode for this UseCase. sync → solid arrow (dispatchSync), async → dashed arrow (dispatchAsync). Applied as CSS class on the node-group wrapper.

Query.description: A Query unit, which is a Unit composed of a single Query class (type Unit, typically colour "query"). Rendered as <div class="node-group sync"> wrapping a single <div class="node query"> element. Always dispatched synchronously. No handler is rendered — query handlers are an implementation detail.

query.description: The Query class unit (typically colour "query"). Rendered as <div class="node query">.

dispatchMode.description: Dispatch mode for queries — always sync.

Event.description: An Event unit, which is a Unit composed of a Domain Event class (type Unit, typically colour "event"). Rendered as <div class="node-group async"> wrapping a single <div class="node event"> element. Always dispatched asynchronously. Listeners are separate nodes in the Listener column.

event.description: The Domain Event class unit (typically colour "event"). Rendered as <div class="node event">.

dispatchMode.description: Dispatch mode for events — always async.

Listener.description: A Listener unit, which is a Unit composed of an EventListener class (type Unit, typically colour "listnr"). Rendered as <div class="node-group"> wrapping a single <div class="node listnr"> element.

listener.description: The EventListener class unit (typically colour "listnr"). Rendered as <div class="node listnr">.

dispatchMode.description: Dispatch mode for listeners — always async.
